bug: Channel 3 holds its current output-delay value instead of clearing it when filter_select is 2'b11.
trigger: After reset, set filter_select to 2'b10 and in_3 to 1 for two consecutive rising edges; y_3_0 becomes 7. Set filter_select to 2'b11 on the next rising edge. On the following edge, out_3 is 7 in the mutant but 0 in the original.
effect: A stale channel 3 result leaks through the output after the reserved filter-select encoding; valid filter-select operation is unchanged.
